# Entries that must NEVER be auto-synced from upstream rpmlint.
# These were deliberately dropped from rpmcrab and must stay dropped.
# The upstream-whitelist-sync workflow checks this list before porting.

# Format: one package/entry name per line. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Matching is done against the `package = "..."` value in TOML stanzas.

# Sources: PR #328 (integration-test fixtures), PR #312 (Tumbleweed-removed
# packages), PR #331 (dead slfo stanzas), and the PRUNE_PACKAGES dict in
# scripts/generate-distro-configs.py.

# Not real distro policy, not shipped in Factory or Leap.
rpmlint-integration-test
